lessons.subtitle: 做一份可执行的短途出游安排
grammar: 综合 going to、已约安排和条件句

vocabulary.example: Here’s our itinerary for Sunday.
Can we reschedule our tour?
The forecast says it’ll rain.

listening.title: Weekly Challenge: Plan a City Break
listening.transcript: The train arrives at nine fifteen. We’re meeting Mei at the station at ten. We’re going to have lunch near the museum. If the museum is full, we’ll visit the market instead.

passages.title: A phone reminder
passages.transcript: Hi, I’m calling from the museum to confirm your booking. We’re holding the planning session on Sunday. It starts at 11 fifteen. You can call back if you’d like to change your booking.

questions.q: On which day does the event take place?
What time does the event begin?

passages.title: At the front desk
passages.transcript: Welcome to the museum! Are you here for the planning session? Please meet us in the Green Room. The session lasts 45 minutes. It begins at 11 fifteen. I can show you where to go.

passages.title: A ticket enquiry
passages.transcript: Thanks for asking about the planning session. It lasts 45 minutes. A ticket costs 8 pounds. We have space for 14 people. We’ll give you a map when you arrive.

passages.title: A message from the organiser
passages.transcript: A quick note for everyone joining the planning session at the museum. There are 14 places. Use the south entrance. Please bring a pencil. If you need help, ask for Omar. See you there!

questions.q: What are visitors asked to bring?

speaking.prompt: 用 90 秒向旅伴确认到站、见面、午饭、备用活动和离开时间。
speaking.sample: We’re meeting Mei at ten. We’re going to see the museum. If it’s full, we’ll visit the market.

practice.prompt: 用两句英语回答「Weekly Challenge: Plan a City Break」的场景。用到 itinerary，并给一个具体细节。
checklist: 与 Weekly Challenge: Plan a City Break 场景有关

practice.prompt: 你想参加 museum 的 planning session。向工作人员询问地点和开始时间。
你的同伴没听清刚才的活动通知。用自己的话复述日期、房间和费用。
同伴无法按时到达 planning session。告诉对方你会怎么办，并询问对方是否同意。
checklist: 用问句确认对方是否同意

reading.title: 做一份可执行的短途出游安排
reading.text: Saturday: the museum requires tickets from 11 a.m. The market closes at 4 p.m. The airport bus leaves the station at 5:30 p.m. Allow 20 minutes to walk back to the station.

questions.q: When does the airport bus leave?

passages.title: Online booking page
passages.text: Planning session bookings close at 12:00. Reserve your place online before that time. Look for a confirmation in your email inbox.

questions.q: When is the online booking deadline?

passages.title: Ticket collection sign
passages.text: Ticket collection: show your confirmation at the museum information desk. If you arrive late, wait by the entrance until a member of staff comes to meet you.

questions.q: Where do you collect your ticket?

passages.title: Payment instructions
passages.text: Pay by card when you book the planning session. Keep the confirmation email until the event is over.

passages.title: Message for participants
passages.text: Plans changed? You can move your booking free of charge until Wednesday. If you arrive late, please wait at the entrance until a member of staff comes to meet you.

writing.prompt: 写 80–100 词行程短信，带至少四个时间点和一个备选方案。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（综合 going to、已约安排和条件句）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

practice.prompt: 给朋友写 2–3 句关于「Weekly Challenge: Plan a City Break」的英语消息，使用 itinerary 并补充一个具体细节。
写 25–40 词邀请朋友参加 planning session，写明时间、房间和要带的物品。
写 25–40 词给将要迟到的朋友，根据阅读通知告诉对方到哪里等、向谁求助。
写 35–50 词说明你在「Weekly Challenge: Plan a City Break」场景中的选择与理由，尽量运用本课语法（综合 going to、已约安排和条件句）。
